name: Call to Arms
summary: At Hammerfall, Drum Fel sends you after the Boulderfist leaders in Stromgarde. After your earlier work, he says it is time to strike the head from the beast.

sections.title: The Head of the Beast
sections.body: Drum Fel says you are ready to help deliver one last great blow. The Boulderfist leaders have made their lair in Stromgarde’s ruins, which he calls a symbol of human frailty. He sends you to hunt down the lords and the shaman who serve them. They lead attacks meant to drive the Horde from these lands.

faq.q: Who sends you to fight the Boulderfist leaders?
faq.answer: Drum Fel sends you from Hammerfall, the Horde outpost in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Where are the Boulderfist lords and shaman located?
faq.answer: The Boulderfist lords and shaman leading the attacks are holed up in Stromgarde’s ruins, Drum Fel says.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the chain?
aliases: what came before call to arms 3
faq.answer: This follows the previous Call to Arms and is the last step in the chain that begins with Tallow in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: What does Drum Fel want done to the Boulderfist leaders?
faq.answer: Drum Fel wants you to kill the lords and shaman leading the attacks in one last great blow. They mean to drive the Horde from these lands.
